pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...f6 9.exf6, 11...Qb6 12.Nc3
pages.notes: Overview generic (claimed White space advantage in an isolated-pawn position); plans vague, plan 3 claimed 12...O-O runs into 13.Nxd5 (unconfirmed) and named Nb5 ambiguously. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...f6 9.Nf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bxe6 (the d3-bishop cannot reach e6); plan 2 missed the critical 9...Nxd4 10.Qh5+ Ke7; overview did not give the line. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f2-f4-f5 behind the knight that goes to f3; plan 3 sent the d7-knight to f8 where the bishop stands. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (first plan 3 rewrite rejected for putting ...Be7 and ...O-O before ...f6, reworded and re-accepted); British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, 8...Qb6 9.O-O
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 called ...Nxd4 a Black pawn sacrifice (it is White's gambit: 9...Nxd4 10.Nxd4 Qxd4 11.Nf3); plan 3 had ...b5-b4 and ...Ba6 for a long diagonal; plan 1 had f4-f5 and Ng3-f5. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, Leningrad, 9.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Bd7-e8-g6 with the king on e8; plan 1 had f4 behind the f3-knight. Rewrote overview and both plans (...Bd7, ...Rc8, ...a5, ...Nb4).

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Closed, Leningrad, 9.O-O a5
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Bd7-e8-g6 with the king on e8. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling in overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Chistyakov Defense, Modern Line
pages.notes: Overview described a pawn structure and centre that are not on the board; plan 4 targeted an e4-pawn that does not exist. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Eliskases Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plans described an isolated d5-pawn for Black; Black has no d-pawn (the extra pawn is on d4 and White regains it). Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Open System
pages.notes: Plans 1-2 had Nd4 with no knight in reach and a d5-d4 push blocked by White's pawn. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Open System, Shaposhnikov Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Bxc5 with Black's own pawn on c5. Rewrite rejected (theory after 4...Nf6 unconfirmed: 5.Bb5+, 5.dxe6, 5.dxc5), old plan 1 kept with British spelling and its reference added to the skips. Plan 2 rewritten (it claimed White accepts with 5.dxc5) and accepted; British spelling in overview.
